findings.evidence: The declarations occur at lines 54, 64, 75, 95, and 155. Mathlib `Analysis/Normed/Operator/Banach.lean` lines 250 and 428 gives `ContinuousLinearMap.isQuotientMap` and `ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective` under `[CompleteSpace E]`, with no `[CompleteSpace F]`.
findings.fix: Omit `[CompleteSpace F]` for these declarations; construct strictness using `T.isQuotientMap hT` (or the range restriction) and retain only `[CompleteSpace E]`.

findings.evidence: The affected declarations are at lines 70, 111, and 134; their proof invokes `Φ.isQuotientMap`, whose Mathlib theorem at `Analysis/Normed/Operator/Banach.lean:250` assumes completeness only of the map's domain.
findings.fix: Omit `[CompleteSpace F]` from the three declarations; the proof's quotient-map step needs completeness of the source `E × N`, not the codomain `F`.
findings.issue: `[CompleteSpace F]` is also unnecessarily inherited by `isClosed_range_of_finite_coker`, `IsFredholm.of_finite_ker_coker`, and `isFredholm_iff_finite_ker_coker`.

summary: Several Fredholm criteria unnecessarily require codomain completeness, although the Mathlib open-mapping and bounded-inverse APIs used here require only domain completeness.
